# USL user guide

This guide ships with the release you are using. Pages marked as tested are
generated from the product's own browser journeys; the others are written by
hand and say so at the bottom.

## Learn

Start here if the product is new to you.

- [Take a guided tour of Accounting](TUTORIAL.md): Walk through Overview, journals, documents, reconciliation, reports, hygiene and declarations without changing posted accounting.

## Complete a task

Goal-shaped steps for work you already understand.

- [Activate, monitor or pause electronic-invoice reception in production](how-to/activate-electronic-invoice-reception.md): Switch the approved reception platform on, watch the first invoices arrive, and pause it safely. (for administrators)
- [Analyze analytic performance](how-to/analyze-analytic-performance.md): Read margin and cost by activity, brand or project from the analytic analysis report. (for the CEO)
- [Create and collect a customer invoice](how-to/process-customer-invoice.md): Issue an invoice, send it, register the payment and confirm it is matched. (for finance operators)
- [Enregistrer et rapprocher la paie TESE](how-to/paie-tese.md) (FR): Saisir le bulletin calculé par TESE, joindre les justificatifs et suivre les dettes jusqu'au règlement. (for accountants)
- [Export reports and the FEC](how-to/export-reports-and-fec.md): Download a report as PDF or XLSX with its current filters, and produce the annual FEC file. (for accountants)
- [Generate official documents](how-to/official-documents.md): Configure a company's document templates and render governed invoices, quotes and letters. (for administrators)
- [Group related expenses into a Batch](how-to/group-expenses-into-a-batch.md): Select the expenses that belong together and add them to a proposed Batch so they share one business context. (for employees)
- [Investigate a report value](how-to/investigate-report-value.md): Trace a figure on a financial report back to the journal items and source documents behind it. (for accountants)
- [Manage bank matching rules](how-to/manage-bank-matching-rules.md): Create, order and test the rules that propose counterparts for bank transactions. (for accountants)
- [Match a bank transaction](how-to/reconcile-bank-transaction.md): Match a bank line against invoices, bills, expenses or a suggested counterpart. (for accountants)
- [Match a foreign bill to a company-currency bank transaction](how-to/settle-immediate-foreign-payment.md): Settle a foreign-currency bill paid by card from the EUR debit the bank reports. (for accountants)
- [Prepare a French declaration](how-to/prepare-declaration.md): Open the next obligation, compare ledger values with external confirmations and record the filing. (for accountants)
- [Prepare electronic-invoice reception](how-to/prepare-electronic-invoice-reception.md): Get the company, partners and approved platform ready before reception is activated. (for administrators)
- [Process a supplier bill](how-to/process-vendor-bill.md): Record a bill from its document, check lines and taxes, post it and match the payment. (for finance operators)
- [Process an expense](how-to/process-expense.md): Capture a receipt, complete the expense, submit it and follow it to reimbursement. (for employees)
- [Process content-platform payouts](how-to/process-platform-payouts.md): Import a platform payout, generate its invoices and bills, and settle it against the bank. (for finance operators)
- [Provide read-only accountant access](how-to/provide-accountant-access.md): Give an external accountant the Accountant Reviewer role on the right companies only. (for administrators)
- [Préparer et suivre une signature électronique](how-to/signatures-electroniques.md) (FR): Préparer le document, désigner les signataires, suivre la signature et conserver la preuve. (for managers)
- [Reconcile a clearing or other account](how-to/reconcile-clearing-account.md): Settle balances on a non-bank account from the general reconciliation workspace. (for accountants)
- [Regrouper et contrôler des dépenses dans un lot](how-to/expense-batches.md) (FR): Créer ou choisir un lot, appliquer le contexte commun, contrôler les lignes signalées et soumettre ensemble. (for employees)
- [Review Accounting Hygiene](how-to/review-accounting-hygiene.md): Work through the deterministic recommendations, open their records and confirm resolution. (for accountants)
- [Review an incoming electronic invoice](how-to/review-incoming-electronic-invoice.md): Check a received e-invoice, accept it as a bill or reject it with a reason. (for finance operators)
- [Review B2C commerce history](how-to/review-b2c-commerce.md): Browse orders, events and settlements imported from the sales channels and open their accounting. (for the CEO)
- [Run a monthly review](how-to/run-monthly-review.md): Clear queues, check hygiene, reconcile, review reports and prepare the closing in one pass. (for accountants)
- [Send product feedback](how-to/send-product-feedback.md): Report a bug, suggest an improvement or ask a question from any page and follow the answer.
- [Sign in with Pocket ID](how-to/sign-in-with-pocket-id.md): Sign in to Odoo and Documents with a passkey through Pocket ID, and recover when it fails.
- [Traiter les encaissements des plateformes de contenu](how-to/traiter-encaissements-plateformes.md) (FR): Importer un versement de plateforme, générer les factures et le rapprocher de la banque. (for finance operators)
- [Try the Documents application](how-to/test-paperless-documents.md): Review the Paperless-backed Documents experience on a test database before relying on it.

## Understand the design

Why the product behaves the way it does.

- [Analytical accounting](explanation/analytical-accounting.md): Why general and analytical accounting answer different questions and how the distribution works. (for the CEO)
- [Closing and lock dates](explanation/closing-and-locks.md): What closing a period commits to and how lock dates protect it. (for accountants)
- [Posting and evidence](explanation/posting-and-evidence.md): Why posting turns preparation into ledger truth and what evidence must travel with it.
- [Reconciliation and residuals](explanation/reconciliation.md): What reconciliation links, what a residual means and when partial matching is right. (for accountants)
- [VAT and declarations](explanation/vat-and-declarations.md): How taxes on documents become tax bases, tags and the French VAT return. (for accountants)

The active company controls the documents and values you see. Use the company
switcher in the top bar before starting a task for another company.
